prompt: An intimate opaque gouache still life at an evening theater box office. A single small tangerine-orange paper admission ticket lies flat across one white cotton glove on the counter. Let the ticket catch the eye immediately: a decisive warm rectangle against a quieter field of cool fabric. Indigo-violet light from the booth falls into the glove's folds; broad milky off-white planes, soft cotton seams and matte overlapping brush shapes keep its white cloth apparent. Suggest the ticket window with subdued shapes behind the counter. Close framing, hand-painted opaque pigment on paper.

A transparent watercolor still life by a teahouse window at sunset. A single small red raspberry rests on a pale celadon-glazed ceramic plate. The raspberry draws the first glance with deep clear crimson, distinct little drupelets and a small contact shadow. Delicate amber window light washes across the setting, catching in a translucent reflection on the glaze; the broad body of the plate retains its own pale blue-green hue. Loose transparent washes and reserved paper light, quiet window details, an intimate view.

A colored-pencil drawing of a carpenter's bench under a blue work light. A small yellow carpenter's pencil is tucked into the pocket of a black leather tool pouch, part of its flattened wooden shaft plainly visible above the pocket. Its crisp yellow shape is the first thing the viewer notices. Model the black leather with deep charcoal-black shadow, restrained cool blue reflections and short strokes that reveal the grain and stitching. Layered pencil hatching and visible paper tooth. Keep surrounding bench details quiet and recognizable.

A natural still-life photograph in a kitchen in cool blue dawn light. One small green olive sits on a shallow copper tray. Compose a close, slightly elevated view so the olive catches the first glance, with clear green skin in sharp focus and a delicate contact shadow. Broad warm reddish-copper midtones and brushed metal texture identify the shallow tray, with soft blue window reflections running across parts of its surface. Gently defocused kitchen surroundings, soft directional window light, realistic exposure and understated color.

A soft-pastel drawing set in a dressing room before a performance, with a gentle pink cast to the light. One small silver dragonfly brooch is pinned to the side of a navy-blue felt hat. Let the eye settle first on the silver dragonfly, with a few precise bright pastel touches on the four wings and slim metal body against soft deep navy. Dusty broken strokes and paper grain describe the fuzzy felt surface; rose light grazes the raised planes while the hat keeps its own navy color. The dressing room is softly suggested around the hat.
